_readme: This is the ONLY file you need to edit. Change the text between the quotes and save.
Keep the quotes, commas and brackets exactly as they are. Check the file at https://jsonlint.com if the site stops loading.
Photos and music: put the files in the assets folder and write their path here (for example assets/music/song.mp3).
Dates: weddingDate and each event start/end use the format 2027-02-14T19:30:00+05:30 (+05:30 = India time).
To preview on your Mac, double-click preview.command (see README.md).

_4: ==================== EVENTS ====================  time: shown on the card. start/end: used for 'Add to calendar' (India time). map: Google Maps link (leave "" to hide Directions). note: small line under the venue, e.g. 'Exact venue to be shared soon' ("" to hide). dress: colour/dress code ("" to hide). hi: small Hindi name above the event ("" to hide). side: groom / bride / both (with ?side=groom in the link, guests see only those events). icon: thali, bowl, leaf, dhol, agni, chandelier. tone: card colour.

_6: ==================== THINGS TO KNOW ====================  icon: weather, dress, stay, travel, parking, gift.

thingsToKnow.title: Two cities, one celebration
thingsToKnow.text: The Tilak and the 11 December reception are in Kolkata. The Haldi, Mehandi & Sangeet and the wedding are in Jamshedpur.

thingsToKnow.title: Weather
thingsToKnow.text: Late November evenings in Jamshedpur and Kolkata are pleasantly cool. Carry a light shawl or jacket for the night functions.

thingsToKnow.title: Getting to Jamshedpur
thingsToKnow.text: Nearest railway station: Tatanagar Junction (TATA). Nearest airports: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi (about 3 hours by road) and Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Airport, Kolkata.

thingsToKnow.title: Your stay
thingsToKnow.text: Coming from out of town? Please call us with your arrival details and we will help you settle in.

thingsToKnow.title: Blessings
thingsToKnow.text: Your presence and blessings are the only gift we wish for.

_7: ==================== FAMILIES ====================  Shown at the end of the invitation, one block per family: the kids' line, 'With best compliments from', and the sender's address. Phone numbers are not shown on the site: guests get 'Call' and 'Save contact' buttons (also in Things to Know).

_8: ==================== MUSIC ====================  Put your songs in assets/music/ and list their paths, e.g. ["assets/music/1.mp3", "assets/music/2.mp3"] (mp3 or m4a). Each visit plays one song picked at random. Leave "" for no music. It starts when the guest taps the seal; a button lets them pause it.
_10: ==================== OPTIONAL PAINTED PICTURES ====================  Leave "" to keep the cartoon couple. To use your own illustration in a story scene, put the file in assets/images/ and write its path (scenes in order: getting married, blessings, groom, bride, save the date; namaste = closing).
